payout_quote: By making a valid referral that is completed by a Friend in accordance with the Program and these Terms, you and the Friend will each receive a cash bonus of $400.00 for a new OMNI membership which is established by the Friend and remains in good standing for a period of at least 60 days.
steps: Get a referral link from an existing OMNI Community Credit Union member and open a new OMNI membership with Savings ($5+ deposit) and Checking (MI/IN eligibility; Friend must be 18+ and new to OMNI).

Within 60 days of account opening: set up ACH direct deposits averaging $500+/month (employer payroll or government benefits; P2P excluded), make 8+ debit card purchases of $5+ each month, enroll in eStatements, and log in to Digital Banking.
Keep the accounts open and in good standing; the $400 bonus is deposited into the OMNI Savings account within 10 business days of the 60-day anniversary of opening.
catches: MI/IN only: must live, work, worship, or attend school in Michigan, or live/work in Elkhart, LaGrange, or St. Joseph County, Indiana.
Friend needs a valid referral code from an OMNI member; cannot refer yourself or solicit strangers; Friend must be 18+ with no OMNI account in the last 12 months.

Friend must open Savings ($5+ deposit) and Checking, then within 60 days: ACH direct deposits averaging $500+/month (payroll or government benefits; P2P excluded), 8+ debit card transactions of $5+ each month, enroll in eStatements, and log in to Digital Banking.
New membership must remain in good standing for at least 60 days; bonuses deposited within 10 business days of the 60-day anniversary; accounts closed before payment forfeit the bonus.
Referrer capped at 5 referrals / $2,000 per calendar year; August 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026 promotion; bonuses reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC.
biggest_catch: You need a referral code from an existing OMNI member, and the friend must route $500/month of payroll direct deposits plus 8 debit purchases each month.
eligibility: Michigan (live/work/worship/attend school) or IN counties of Elkhart, LaGrange, St. Joseph; Friend must be 18+, new to OMNI (no account in last 12 months), join via a member's referral link; referrer limited to 5 referrals/year.
timing: Bonus paid within 10 business days of the 60-day anniversary of account opening.
